infoCards.title: Quality Control
infoCards.description: Comprehensive quality management for metal fabrication processes.

faqData.question: How does the system manage custom fabrication projects?
faqData.answer: Our system provides comprehensive project management with detailed job tracking, material requirements planning, cost estimation and real-time progress monitoring for custom fabrication work.

faqData.question: What quality control features are included?
faqData.answer: The system includes advanced quality control features with inspection planning, weld quality tracking, dimensional verification, material certification management and detailed quality reporting.

faqData.question: Can it handle machine and tool management?
faqData.answer: Yes, our solution manages machine scheduling, tool lifecycle tracking, preventive maintenance planning and performance monitoring for optimal equipment utilization.
